<documents>
<document id="card-expedited-shipping">
ExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆExpeditedˆshippingˆgetsˆaˆnewˆorˆreplacementˆcardˆtoˆyouˆinˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆinsteadˆofˆtheˆusualˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆCostˆbyˆplanˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆTheˆshippingˆfeeˆisˆseparateˆfromˆanyˆcardˆreplacementˆfee.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆlostˆcardˆsentˆexpeditedˆcostsˆbothˆfees.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆchooseˆitˆWhenˆyouˆorderˆaˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆpickˆExpeditedˆonˆtheˆshippingˆscreen.ˆYouˆcan'tˆupgradeˆtheˆshippingˆspeedˆafterˆtheˆcardˆisˆmailed.ˆ##ˆTrackingˆExpeditedˆcardsˆshipˆwithˆtracking.ˆTheˆlinkˆappearsˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆCardsˆonceˆtheˆcardˆleavesˆourˆfacility.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆonlyˆavailableˆtoˆUSˆaddresses.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆwhoˆareˆabroadˆcanˆaskˆforˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆinstead.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-unauthorized">
Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆIfˆyouˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorize,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆFirst,ˆprotectˆyourˆcardˆBeforeˆweˆopenˆanˆunauthorizedˆdispute,ˆtheˆcardˆusedˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThatˆstopsˆmoreˆchargesˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆIfˆtheˆcardˆisˆstillˆinˆyourˆwallet,ˆfreezingˆisˆenough.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆReportˆanˆunauthorizedˆtransactionˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆdateˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆStatementsˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆcalendarˆdayˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆForˆexample,ˆaˆtransactionˆthatˆpostedˆinˆMarchˆappearsˆonˆtheˆMarchˆstatement,ˆsoˆtheˆwindowˆrunsˆfromˆtheˆendˆofˆMarch.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆIfˆyourˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆMostˆinvestigationsˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆForeignˆtransactions,ˆandˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆYourˆliabilityˆYouˆaren'tˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆreportedˆwithinˆtheˆwindow.ˆ##ˆNotˆsureˆit'sˆunauthorized?ˆUnfamiliarˆnamesˆareˆoftenˆaˆmerchant'sˆparentˆcompanyˆorˆaˆpaymentˆprocessor.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆseeˆtheˆmerchant'sˆdetailsˆbeforeˆyouˆdisputeˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-zero-liability">
ZeroˆliabilityˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆuseˆYouˆaren'tˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆifˆyouˆreportˆthemˆinˆtime.ˆ##ˆWhatˆcountsˆasˆinˆtimeˆReportˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆdateˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆStatementsˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆcalendarˆdayˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆcoveredˆ-ˆPurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆmadeˆwithˆyourˆcardˆorˆcardˆnumberˆwithoutˆyourˆpermissionˆ-ˆMobileˆwalletˆpaymentsˆmadeˆwithˆaˆdeviceˆyouˆdon'tˆcontrolˆ##ˆWhatˆisn'tˆcoveredˆ-ˆPurchasesˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆorˆPINˆtoˆ-ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆandˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆevenˆifˆyouˆwereˆtrickedˆintoˆsendingˆthemˆ-ˆTransactionsˆreportedˆafterˆtheˆwindowˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆyourˆcardˆfirst,ˆthenˆdisputeˆeachˆtransactionˆasˆunauthorizedˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
